title: Five short recordings: messages and announcements
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short recordings.

script.t: One. You will hear a woman leaving a message. Why is she calling?
Hi Lan, it's Huong. Thanks for lending me your bike last week. I'm sorry, but I can't give it back on Friday like I said. My brother needs to use it. Is Sunday OK? Call me back.
Two. You will hear an announcement. Where is the man speaking?
Good afternoon. The four fifteen to Hue is now leaving from platform two, not platform five. Passengers with large bags, please use the lift at the end of the hall.
Three. You will hear two friends talking. What are they talking about?
Did you see it at the cinema last night? The ending was so sad!
I fell asleep before the end. But the music was great, and the actors were really good.
Four. You will hear a teacher talking to her class. What does she want the students to do?
OK, everyone. Before you go home, please put your chairs on the tables. The cleaners are coming early today. And don't forget, homework is on page twenty.
Five. You will hear a man talking about his holiday. How did he feel about it?
Everyone said the island was boring, but I loved it. There was no internet and no work. I just read books on the beach all day.

opts.t: to say sorry for a mistake

ev.s: Is Sunday OK?

items.why: Hương gọi để đổi ngày trả xe từ thứ Sáu sang Chủ nhật.

wrong.A: Hương không nhờ Lan giúp gì.
wrong.B: Hương xin lỗi vì đổi ngày, không phải vì làm sai điều gì.

ev.s: is now leaving from platform two

items.why: Có giờ tàu, sân ga (platform) nên đây là ga tàu.

wrong.B: Thang máy cũng có ở khách sạn, nhưng giờ tàu và sân ga cho biết đây là ga.
wrong.C: Sân bay dùng "gate", không dùng "platform".

ev.s: the actors were really good

items.why: Họ nói về đoạn kết, âm nhạc và diễn viên của một bộ phim.

wrong.A: Họ xem ở rạp chiếu phim, không phải nhà hát.
wrong.B: Có nhắc âm nhạc, nhưng có diễn viên và xem ở rạp phim.

items.q: What does she want the students to do?

opts.t: do their homework before going home

ev.s: please put your chairs on the tables

items.why: Cô dặn đặt ghế lên bàn.

wrong.A: Người dọn vệ sinh tự làm, học sinh chỉ đặt ghế lên bàn.
wrong.C: Cô chỉ nhắc trang bài tập về nhà.

items.q: How did he feel about it?

ev.s: I just read books on the beach all day.

items.why: Không mạng, không việc, đọc sách cả ngày trên bãi biển: ông thấy thư thái.

wrong.B: Người khác nói đảo chán, nhưng ông rất thích.
wrong.C: Ông rất thích kỳ nghỉ.

title: Five short recordings: around town
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short recordings.

script.t: One. You will hear a man on the phone. Who is he talking to?
Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please. One of my back teeth hurts when I eat something cold. Is there anything free tomorrow morning?
Two. You will hear a woman in a shop. What does she want?
I bought this shirt here yesterday, but it's too small. I don't want my money back. Have you got the same one, but in a large?
Three. You will hear an announcement in a supermarket. What is it about?
Attention, shoppers. Would the owner of the small red car near the main door please go to the car park? Your lights are still on.
Four. You will hear two people talking. Where are they?
Two adults, please. Is there a show with the dolphins today?
Yes, at two o'clock. And don't miss the sharks in the big tank downstairs.
Five. You will hear a boy talking about his weekend. What did he do?
My dad and I got up really early and drove to the lake. We wanted to go camping, but it was too cold. So we sat there all morning and caught nothing! But in the afternoon I caught three big ones.

ev.s: One of my back teeth hurts

items.why: Ông đặt lịch vì đau răng: gọi phòng khám nha khoa.

wrong.A: Ông đặt lịch hẹn khám, hiệu thuốc không có lịch hẹn.
wrong.C: Đau răng thì gọi nha sĩ, không phải bác sĩ thường.

ev.s: Have you got the same one, but in a large?

items.why: Bà muốn đổi sang cỡ lớn.

wrong.A: Áo quá nhỏ nên bà cần cỡ lớn hơn.
wrong.C: Bà nói không muốn lấy lại tiền.

ev.s: Your lights are still on.

items.why: Thông báo nói về chiếc ô tô đỏ còn bật đèn.

wrong.A: Thông báo tìm chủ xe, không tìm trẻ lạc.
wrong.C: Không có ưu đãi nào được nhắc.

ev.s: don't miss the sharks in the big tank downstairs

items.why: Có cá heo, cá mập trong bể lớn: đây là thủy cung.

wrong.B: Ở bãi biển không có bể cá ở tầng dưới.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc thuyền.

ev.s: in the afternoon I caught three big ones

items.why: Cậu ngồi cả buổi và bắt được ba con cá to: đi câu cá.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc thuyền buồm.
wrong.B: Họ muốn cắm trại nhưng trời quá lạnh.

title: Five short recordings: school and work
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short recordings.

script.t: One. You will hear a woman talking to a colleague. Why is she worried?
The computer isn't the problem, it works fine now. But I can't find the report for the meeting. I'm sure I saved it this morning.
Two. You will hear a student talking about a lesson. Which subject is he talking about?
Today we mixed two liquids and they turned blue. Then we heated them and wrote down the temperature every minute.
Three. You will hear a man talking about his job. What is his job?
I start at five in the morning. I check the plane before the passengers get on, and then I fly people to Da Nang and back twice a day.
Four. You will hear a girl talking to her friend. What does she want to do?
I'm not going to the party. I'm really tired. I'd just like to stay in, have something to eat and go to bed early.
Five. You will hear a message from a school. Why are they calling?
Hello, this is Mrs Thu from Hoa Sen School. Your son has a bad headache, so he's lying down in the school office. Could you come and take him home?

opts.t: She is late for a meeting.

ev.s: I can't find the report for the meeting.

items.why: Bà không tìm thấy bản báo cáo.

wrong.B: Máy tính giờ chạy tốt.
wrong.C: Bà không nói bị muộn họp.

items.q: Which subject is he talking about?

ev.s: Today we mixed two liquids and they turned blue.

items.why: Trộn chất lỏng, đun nóng, ghi nhiệt độ: môn khoa học.

wrong.A: Màu xanh xuất hiện, nhưng là phản ứng hoá học, không phải vẽ.
wrong.B: Có đun nóng, nhưng trộn chất lỏng đổi màu và ghi nhiệt độ là thí nghiệm.

ev.s: I fly people to Da Nang and back twice a day

items.why: Ông kiểm tra máy bay và bay chở khách: phi công.

wrong.A: Ông đưa khách đi Đà Nẵng nhưng là lái máy bay.
wrong.B: Ông chở khách, nhưng bằng máy bay.

items.q: What does she want to do?

opts.t: go to bed after the party

ev.s: I'd just like to stay in

items.why: Cô muốn ở nhà, ăn chút gì và đi ngủ sớm.

wrong.A: Cô nói không đi dự tiệc.
wrong.C: Cô muốn ăn ở nhà ("stay in").

ev.s: Your son has a bad headache

items.why: Con trai bị đau đầu nặng, cần đón về.

wrong.B: Cậu không làm gì sai.
wrong.C: Không ai nói cậu quên đồ.

title: Five short recordings: free time
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short recordings.

script.t: One. You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant. What did she like best?
The waiters were friendly but very slow, and the food was OK, nothing special. What I really liked was the bill. It was so cheap! I'll go back for that.
Two. You will hear two friends talking. What are they going to do?
It's too hot to play football. Let's go to the pool.
It's closed today. What about watching a film at my house? We've got a fan.
OK, that's fine.
Three. You will hear a man talking about a book. What does he say about it?
My friend said it was difficult, but I didn't think so. It's quite long, but I couldn't stop reading. I finished it in two days.
Four. You will hear a girl talking about a hobby. What is her hobby?
I take my camera everywhere. I like birds and flowers best. Last month some of my pictures were in a magazine!
Five. You will hear a radio report. What is it about?
The city football team won again last night, three goals to one. That's their sixth win this season. Their next game is on Sunday at home.

ev.s: What I really liked was the bill.

items.why: Bà thích nhất là hoá đơn rất rẻ.

wrong.B: Đồ ăn bình thường.
wrong.C: Phục vụ thân thiện nhưng rất chậm.

items.q: What are they going to do?

ev.s: What about watching a film at my house?

items.why: Họ chốt xem phim ở nhà cô bé.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc đá bóng trong nhà.
wrong.B: Bể bơi hôm nay đóng cửa.

items.q: What does he say about it?

ev.s: I couldn't stop reading

items.why: Ông không thể ngừng đọc: sách rất hay.

wrong.A: Sách khá dài.
wrong.C: Bạn ông thấy khó, ông thì không.

ev.s: I take my camera everywhere.

items.why: Cô mang máy ảnh khắp nơi: sở thích là chụp ảnh.

wrong.B: Cô chụp chim, hoa chứ không vẽ.
wrong.C: Tạp chí đăng ảnh cô chụp, không phải bài cô viết.

ev.s: The city football team won again last night

items.why: Bản tin nói về kết quả trận bóng.

wrong.A: Trận sau đá trên sân nhà, không nói sân mới.
wrong.C: Không nói thời tiết.

title: Five short recordings: travel
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short recordings.

script.t: One. You will hear a woman at a hotel. What is the problem?
Excuse me, I booked a room for two nights, but your computer says one night. I've got the email here. Can you check again?
Two. You will hear an announcement on a plane. What should passengers do now?
Ladies and gentlemen, we will land in twenty minutes. Please go back to your seats now and put on your seat belts. Shopping is now closed.
Three. You will hear a man asking for directions. Where does he want to go?
Excuse me, I'm looking for somewhere to post this letter. The man in the bank said it's near here, next to a cafe.
Four. You will hear a girl talking about a trip. How did she travel?
We wanted to fly, but the tickets were too expensive, and the train was full. So we went by bus. It took twenty hours, but we had beds!
Five. You will hear a tour guide. What will the group do next?
OK everyone, we've finished at the temple. We'll walk to the market now, and have lunch there. After lunch, we'll take the boat back to the hotel.

ev.s: your computer says one night

items.why: Bà đặt hai đêm nhưng máy ghi một đêm.

wrong.B: Bà không nói về giá.
wrong.C: Bà không nói về loại phòng.

opts.t: buy something before the shop closes
get ready to leave the plane

ev.s: Please go back to your seats now

items.why: Hành khách phải về chỗ ngồi, thắt dây an toàn.

wrong.A: Mua hàng đã đóng rồi.
wrong.B: Còn hai mươi phút nữa mới hạ cánh.

items.q: Where does he want to go?

ev.s: I'm looking for somewhere to post this letter.

items.why: Ông muốn gửi thư: tìm bưu điện.

wrong.A: Quán cà phê là mốc ở cạnh bưu điện.
wrong.C: Ngân hàng là nơi ông vừa hỏi đường.

ev.s: So we went by bus.

items.why: Họ đi xe buýt giường nằm.

wrong.A: Vé máy bay quá đắt.
wrong.B: Tàu đã hết chỗ.

items.q: What will the group do next?

ev.s: We'll walk to the market now

items.why: Đoàn sẽ đi bộ ra chợ ngay bây giờ.

wrong.A: Đi thuyền là sau bữa trưa.
wrong.C: Đoàn vừa thăm đền xong.

title: Five short recordings: home and people
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short recordings.

script.t: One. You will hear a man talking about his neighbour. What does he say about her?
She's eighty, but she's very busy. She teaches children to swim every morning and grows vegetables in her garden. She never sits down!
Two. You will hear a woman talking on the phone. Why can't she come?
I'm sorry, I can't come to the meeting. My car is fine, and I'm not ill. It's my daughter. She's got a high temperature, so I need to stay with her.
Three. You will hear a boy talking about his room. What has he changed?
My room is the same size, and I've still got the same bed. But I've painted the walls green. It looks really different now.
Four. You will hear two friends talking. What are they doing?
Turn left here. No, not this road, the next one.
Are you sure? I think we're lost. Let's look at the map on my phone.
Five. You will hear a woman talking about her family. Who does she live with?
My son is at university in Canada, and my daughter has her own flat now. So it's just my husband and me, and our two cats.

items.q: What does he say about her?

ev.s: She never sits down!

items.why: Bà tám mươi tuổi nhưng rất bận rộn: rất năng động.

wrong.B: Ông không nói bà hay ốm.
wrong.C: Bà dạy bơi cho trẻ em, không thích ở một mình.

ev.s: She's got a high temperature

items.why: Con gái bà sốt cao.

wrong.B: Bà nói xe vẫn tốt.
wrong.C: Bà nói mình không ốm.

ev.s: I've painted the walls green

items.why: Cậu sơn tường màu xanh lá.

wrong.A: Phòng vẫn rộng như cũ.
wrong.B: Giường vẫn như cũ.

ev.s: I think we're lost.

items.why: Họ đang tìm đường, nghĩ mình bị lạc.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc nhà hàng.
wrong.C: Điện thoại chỉ dùng để xem bản đồ.

ev.s: So it's just my husband and me

items.why: Bà sống với chồng (và hai con mèo).

wrong.A: Con gái đã có căn hộ riêng.
wrong.B: Con trai học đại học ở Canada.
